summary: Ero Copper Corp. furnished a Form 6-K attaching its 2025 Sustainability Report, a routine annual ESG disclosure covering calendar 2025, filed September 24, 2026. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, or board recommendation is stated. The report, the company's sixth annual, references GRI Standards and SASB Metals and Mining disclosures and is incorporated by reference into existing Form S-8 and Form F-10 registration statements. No structural, regulatory, or ownership mechanics arise. No risk-arb angle applies; this is ordinary foreign-private-issuer current reporting, not a special situation.
